LatexTerm is now a native macOS terminal for working with **Claude Code and Codex**: panes that aren't only terminals sit next to the chat, and math still renders as math.

### Highlights
- **Scratchpad** — sketch, press ➤, the drawing lands in the agent's prompt; the agent draws the clean version back.
- **Preview** — PDFs, images and Office files beside the chat, reload on change, SyncTeX jumps; mark a passage and send it with page, source line and a crop.
- **Web** — local HTML or a `http://localhost` dev server, browser-like; ⌥-click an element and `⇧⌘⏎` hands it to the agent with selector and source line.
- **Built for agents** — `latexterm` CLI and MCP server: agents open panes, start and ask other sessions, and look at or operate what a pane shows.
- **Home and ⌘K** — projects, sessions and quotas for Claude and Codex; resume or search across sessions.
- **Session state** — title-bar chips and notifications when a pane is done or needs you.
- **Tabs and restart** — `⌥⌘R` brings every pane, tab and agent session back.
- **Looks** — Ghostty themes and config import, JetBrains Mono, new app icon, desktop widgets.

Full list in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/MatsLuca/LatexTerm/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#020---2026-09-23). The interface is German for now.

### Install
Download `LatexTerm-v0.2.0-macos.zip`, unzip, move `LatexTerm.app` to `/Applications`. The build is ad-hoc signed, not notarized — on first launch macOS blocks it: open **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**, or run

```sh
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LatexTerm.app
```

Let agents drive it (optional):

```sh
ln -s /Applications/LatexTerm.app/Contents/Helpers/latexterm /opt/homebrew/bin/latexterm
claude mcp add -s user latexterm -- /opt/homebrew/bin/latexterm mcp
```

Requires macOS 14+. Desktop widgets rely on an app group and may not work in this unsigned download.
